spans.s:
mf. (-लः-ली)
A short jacket, a bodice.
m. (-लः) or m. plu. (-लाः)
A country, the modern Tanjore, the name is also supposed to apply to a part of Birbhum, in Bengal.
E.
चुल to be high or to elevate, affix अच, and ल being changed to ड, चोड ut sup. or चोल a proper name, that of the king of the country applied to the country.

m. (-कः)
A breastplate, a cuirass.
n. (-कं)
Bark, rind.
E.
चुल to elevate, affix वुन्.

m. (-की)
1 The shoot of the bambu.
2 The wrist.
3 The orange.
4 A cuirassier, a soldier armed with a breastplate.
E.
चोलक armour, rind, &c. and इनि aff.

m. (-कः)
A diadem, a fillet for the head, a turban or tiara.
